provenance.clerk_text: Filed 45 years of monthly temperature (Temperature at 2 Meters, degC) for Northern Yucatan, Mexico, 1981-01 to 2025-12, averaged over 9 points. Source: NASA POWER Monthly & Annual API, accessed 2026-11-14.
